description: Test a running API you own for IDOR / BOLA (OWASP API #1, the #1 vuln AI builders ship): can one logged-in user read ANOTHER user's objects by changing the ID? You provide TWO test-account bearer tokens (A and B) and the resource endpoints; for each resource, user A lists their own objects, then user B tries to read them by ID. A 200 = a real IDOR. Also flags collections readable with no token. Read-only (GET only), bounded. CONSENT REQUIRED. Use TWO DISPOSABLE TEST ACCOUNTS on a non-production environment, never real customer IDs. Provide two bearer tokens, OR test-account credentials plus a `login` config and ShipSafe fetches the tokens for you (Supabase Auth or a generic JWT endpoint). Tokens are used read-only and never stored.

confirmOwnership.description: Must be true: you own/operate this API and these are test accounts you authorize testing.

login.description: Auto-login config: with accountA/accountB, ShipSafe fetches both test tokens for you. Supabase Auth or a generic JWT-returning endpoint only; cookie/session auth (Clerk, NextAuth) is not supported, pass raw tokens for those.

emailField.description: Body field name for the email (generic; default 'email').

loginUrl.description: Login endpoint that returns a JWT (provider 'generic').

passwordField.description: Body field name for the password (generic; default 'password').

resources.description: The resources to test for cross-user access.

itemTemplate.description: Item path with a {id} placeholder, e.g. /api/v1/chats/{id}.

list.description: Collection path A lists from, e.g. /api/v1/chats.

tokenA.description: Bearer token for TEST account A. Provide this OR `login` + accountA to fetch it automatically.

tokenB.description: Bearer token for TEST account B. Provide this OR `login` + accountB to fetch it automatically.

name: shipsafe_scan_api

unchecked.description: Checks that never reached the API (blocked, failed, or nothing to test). Non-empty means the result is NOT clean.

title: Test a live API for IDOR / broken object-level authorization
